(Japanese: '''チラーミィはきれいずき！？''' ''{{tt|Chillarmy|Minccino}} is a Neat Freak!?'') is the 13th episode of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'', and the 670th episode of the [[Pokémon animated series]]. It first aired in Japan on December 16, 2010 and in the United States on April 30, 2011. {{spoilers}} ==Blurb== As Ash and friends continue their journey toward Nacrene City and his next Gym battle, they meet up with Bianca, who was sent by Professor Juniper with a gift for Ash: a case for his Gym Badges. But when Bianca hands over the dusty case, it’s quickly grabbed by a Minccino, who loves to keep things clean and shiny! Bianca goes after Minccino to get Ash’s case back, and brings out her Pignite to help. But Minccino proves to be a tough opponent, which makes Bianca want to catch it! After Minccino takes out Bianca’s Pignite and then Ash’s Oshawott, it runs off with the Badge case. Bianca lures the Pokémon out of hiding by rubbing one of Cilan’s shiny spoons in the dirt. When Minccino shows up to “rescue” the spoon, Bianca is determined to catch it, and pulls a dusty Poké Ball from her bag. Minccino sees the dirty Poké Ball and can’t resist giving it a shine—and much to everyone’s surprise, the Poké Ball activates and captures Minccino! After Ash reclaims his Badge case, Bianca challenges him to a battle, which Ash and Pikachu win handily. And so, vowing to improve by the time they meet next, Bianca says goodbye to our heroes, and wishes Ash good luck for his upcoming Nacrene City Gym Battle! ==Plot== On their way to [[Nacrene City]], {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} walk along a path and turn around when they hear the voice of a young girl telling them to hold on. She fumbles and she knocks Ash and {{An|Cilan}} into the river, with {{An|Iris}} dodging her. Apologizing repeatedly, she says she is on an errand looking for Ash and pulls out her [[Xtransceiver]]. [[Professor Juniper]] shows up on the screen. After finding out Ash [[BW006|got his first Unova League Badge]], Juniper says she forgot to give him a Badge case, and she sent {{an|Bianca}}, the young girl they are with. Bianca turns off her Xtransceiver and officially introduces herself. She goes through her purse, looking for the Badge case and struggling to find it at first. The Badge case is dirty and she hands it to Ash. Ash takes it and puts his {{Badge|Trio}} inside. Bianca asks if she can take a look at it. Ash hands the Badge case over but a Pokémon takes it and runs away. They give chase and {{AP|Pikachu}} runs ahead, the two Pokémon quickly getting out of sight. Bianca suggests that Ash should ask for another Badge but Ash says the Badge holds the strong feelings of his Pokémon and himself. After hearing Pikachu, they find the Pokémon rubbing the Badge case with his tail. Bianca looks the Pokémon up on her [[Pokédex]], revealing him to be a {{TP|Bianca|Minccino}}. Excited, she plans to capture it. Minccino grabs the Badge case as Bianca calls out her {{TP|Bianca|Pignite}}, which Ash scans with his Pokédex. Pignite begins with a {{M|Tackle}} but Minccino swiftly dodges. Pignite uses {{m|Flame Charge}} and collides with Minccino but Minccino climbs up a tree. Minccino puts down the Badge case and uses {{m|Hyper Voice}}, stopping Pignite. Minccino uses {{m|Tickle}} on Pignite, rendering him useless, and Bianca [[recall]]s him. Ash prepares to battle him with Pikachu but {{TP|Ash|Oshawott}} comes out of his {{i|Poké Ball}} on his own, so Ash lets him battle instead. Oshawott starts with a Tackle but Minccino jumps up to dodge. Bianca excitedly tells Oshawott to use {{m|Hydro Pump}}, which confuses Oshawott. Ash tells her that he cannot use Hydro Pump and tells him to use {{m|Razor Shell}}. Oshawott uses Razor Shell but Minccino is gone. Minccino climbs up a tree and Bianca tells Oshawott to use Razor Shell again but Oshawott sighs. Minccino sneaks up on Oshawott and uses Tickle, followed by {{m|Double Slap}}, [[Fainting|defeating]] Oshawott. As Minccino takes the Badge case and leaves, Ash agrees to help Bianca get Minccino. Elsewhere, [[Team Rocket trio|Team Rocket]] has arrived in Nacrene City. Using a device, they attempt to locate the [[Nacrene Museum|museum]]. Back with Ash and his friends, Bianca comes up with an idea. She asks Cilan if he has anything shiny. He gives her a spoon and she gets it dirty, much to Cilan's dismay. Iris comments that Minccino will be lured because he cannot resist cleaning dirty things. Using a stick, a rope, and a pan, she puts the dirty spoon in the trap. Minccino takes the bait and she pulls the rope, which drops the pan on Minccino. Minccino leaves with the pan over his head and Ash realizes he will need to defeat him. Ash and the others find Minccino and Ash calls on {{AP|Snivy}}. Bianca comments that Ash has a lot of Pokémon. Cilan asks how many Pokémon Bianca has, and she says Pignite is her only Pokémon. Her father did not allow her to become a Trainer, so she trained at home and just started her journey, having two Badges. Snivy uses {{m|Attract}} but Minccino dodges, countering with his own Attract. Snivy gets hit by it and becomes [[Infatuation|infatuated]] with Minccino, forcing Ash to recall the {{pkmn|category|Grass Snake Pokémon}} and send Pikachu to battle Minccino in her place. Pikachu starts things off with an {{m|Iron Tail}} that Minccino dodges. Pikachu follows it up by chasing Minccino with {{m|Quick Attack}}. The two collide with Iron Tail and Double Slap. They dart away and Minccino uses Hyper Voice, followed by Tickle. Pikachu withstands the attacks and Minccino is tired out. In a burst of jubilant enthusiasm, Bianca exclaims for Pikachu to use {{m|Zap Cannon}}; however, Ash informs her that Pikachu cannot use that move, much to Bianca's annoyance. By Ash's command, Pikachu shocks Minccino with a {{m|Thunderbolt}}. Bianca tries to bring out a Poké Ball, but she struggles to find one. Minccino gets away but she brings out a dusty Poké Ball, which makes Minccino come back. He attempts to clean it, but activates the Poké Ball, capturing himself and leaving everyone baffled. Ash gets his Badge case but falls out of the tree, with the pan hitting him. Later, Ash and the others are at the [[Pokémon Center]] where [[Nurse Joy]] has healed Ash and Bianca's Pokémon. She also says that Ash's {{pkmn|Egg}} is healthy. Bianca asks what's in the Egg, but Ash doesn't know. Bianca asks Ash for a battle, which he agrees to, saying it will be 1 on 1. Bianca uses Pignite but Iris assumed she'd use Minccino. Ash is about to decide on who to use but Bianca interrupts, saying she wants to battle Pikachu. Pikachu accepts and uses Quick Attack. Pignite uses {{m|Take Down}} and hits Pikachu. Pignite uses {{m|Heat Crash}} and pins down Pikachu. Pikachu gets up and Bianca grows more excited about how strong Pikachu is. Pignite uses Flame Charge, while Pikachu uses {{m|Volt Tackle}}. The smoke clears and Pignite falls, while Pikachu is still standing, making Ash the winner. Bianca walks up to Ash and says she will get stronger the next time they meet. She wishes Ash good luck in his upcoming Gym battle and leaves. ==Major events== [[File:Ash Unova Badge Case.png|thumb|220px|Ash holding his new Badge case]] * {{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} meet {{an|Bianca}}, a beginning {{pkmn|Trainer}}. * Ash receives a new [[Badge]] case from Bianca, given to her by [[Professor Juniper]]. * The [[Team Rocket trio]] arrive in [[Nacrene City]]. * Bianca {{pkmn2|Caught|catches}} a {{TP|Bianca|Minccino}}. * Ash battles Bianca and wins. {{animeevents|BW}} ===Debuts=== ====Humans==== * {{an|Bianca}} ====Pokémon debuts==== * {{p|Pignite}} ({{OP|Bianca|Pignite}}) * [[Bianca's Minccino]] ==Characters== ===Humans=== * {{Ash}} * {{an|Iris}} * {{an|Cilan}} * [[Jessie]] * [[James]] * {{an|Bianca}} * [[Professor Juniper]] * [[Nurse Joy]] ===Pokémon=== [[File:WTP BW013.png|200px|thumb|right|Who's That Pokémon?]] [[Who's That Pokémon?]]: {{p|Minccino}} * {{p|Pikachu}} ({{OP|Ash|Pikachu}}) * {{p|Meowth}} ({{TRM}}) * {{p|Axew}} ({{OP|Iris|Axew}}) * {{p|Oshawott}} ({{OP|Ash|Oshawott}}) * {{p|Snivy}} ({{OP|Ash|Snivy}}) * {{p|Audino}} ({{OP|Nurse Joy|Audino}}) * {{p|Pignite}} ({{OP|Bianca|Pignite}}; debut) * {{p|Minccino}} ({{OP|Bianca|Minccino}}; new) ==Trivia== [[File:Legend Badge slot.png|thumb|200px|The original Badge slots in Ash's Unova Badge case]] * [[Professor Oak's Pokémon Live Caster]]: {{p|Pansage}} * {{an|Bianca}} [[breaking the fourth wall|breaks the fourth wall]] in this episode by waving to the audience after introducing herself. * The depiction of {{Ash}}'s [[Badge]] case in this episode differs significantly from how it would look in ''[[BW055|Scraggy and the Demanding Gothita!]]'' onward. In this episode, the slots are all shaped like the Badges in {{game|Black and White|s}}, like they are in the {{player}}'s Badge case in said {{pkmn|games}}. As of ''Scraggy and the Demanding Gothita!'', the slots were changed to plain oval shapes to accommodate for the then-upcoming release of {{B2W2}} and Ash earning the {{badge|Toxic}} as his eighth and final Unova Badge instead of the {{badge|Legend}}, which would go on to be completely unseen. ===Errors=== * After {{TP|Bianca|Pignite}} loses to {{AP|Pikachu}}, its left hand is colored the same as its feet. * During the [[Who's That Pokémon?]] segment, as well as the [[title card]], {{p|Minccino}} is [[List of typos|misspelled]] as ''Mincinno'' in the premiere of this episode. Both of these errors were corrected in the reruns, home video, and streaming releases. ** This misspelling is also present in all {{pmin|the Czech Republic|Czech}} dub releases of this episode. * In the {{pmin|Poland|Polish}} [[dub]], {{m|Take Down}} is called {{m|Body Slam}}.
